# GEDCOM 5.5.1 records, values, extensions and dialects.
#
# Format: `### ID | C|L | purpose (origin)`, then the GEDCOM input, then directives:
#   #want LINE    the written output contains this line
#   #model TEXT   the parsed model keeps this text (newline written \n)
#   #lacks TEXT   the written output does not contain this text
#   #target VERS  write as 5.5.1, 7.0 or 7.1 instead of the input's version
# Tokens: <CR> / <CRLF> end a line with that terminator, <NOEOL> ends the input without one,
# <TAB>, <BOM> and <U+XXXX> stand for those characters. Every name, place and value is fictitious.

### G5-CONC-TRAILING-SPACE | L | FTM-style CONC: space at end of previous line (gramps imp_test_FTM_CONC)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
2 NOTE The FTM way --> 
3 CONC <--
2 NOTE The spec way -->
3 CONC  <--
0 TRLR
#model The FTM way --> <--
#model The spec way --> <--

### G5-CUSTOM-AFTER-CONT | C | custom tag after CONT/CONC lines (gedcom4j customtagstorture/famhist/willis _FOOT)
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE First line
2 CONT second line
2 _H custom after cont
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 2 _H custom after cont

0 TRLR
#want 3 _LINK https://example.org/record/1
